thread:
maya: Heads-up: I'm iterating on the Dedicated Capacity docs to make autoscale + SLA examples clearer. Opening a PR shortly. Would love quick reviews on wording and one-liner examples for teams to copy.

liam: Great. Can you include a compact YAML showing label-based routing + scale policy? Those snippets get reused a lot.

maya: Adding this short YAML example to the runbook:
```yaml
tenant_id: "acme-42"
labels:
  - finance
  - priority:high
scale_policy:
  min: 1
  max: 30
  cooldown: 180
isolation:
  mode: committed
  allow_preemption: false
```

sam: Minor: the runtime API uses `minReplicas`/`maxReplicas` in examples elsewhere. We should pick one shape and include a tiny mapping note.

priscilla: I'll add a JS SDK example in docs/examples/dedicated/sdk-quickstart.md and link back. Something like:
```js
// set labels and request dedicated capacity
await client.dedicated.create({ tenantId: 'acme-42', labels: ['finance','priority:high'], scalePolicy: { minReplicas: 1, maxReplicas: 30 } });
```

yuki: For the SLA section, propose we add an "illustrative" table that contrasts Committed vs Best-effort. Make sure the text explicitly says "non-contractual examples". Also add a short paragraph clarifying what "isolation mode: committed" implies for preemption and reserved pools.

maya: Good call. Draft doc text: "Committed capacity: reserved pool backed, preemption disabled; prioritized routing; p95 illustrative target: 200ms for workloads under provisioned QPS. Best-effort: shared pools, subject to preemption under heavy load; p95 illustrative target: best-effort." Thoughts?

sam: Sounds fine as long as we don't accidentally make it read like a guarantee. Maybe add a callout: "If you need contractual SLAs, contact sales/enterprise".

liam: One tiny link nit: the runbook references an older CLI path `/old/provision` 10 - should point to `/docs/cli/dedicated.md`.

maya: Fixed the link in the branch and pushed. Also added a subsection: "Rollback from Dedicated to Shared: checklist" that enumerates steps and considerations (token rotation, traffic shifting, monitoring).

priscilla: Pushed the JS snippet and a short Azure/Terraform example as a follow-up commit. I also added inline comments for the UX string "workspace" vs "tenant" usage.

yuki: Editorial note: Use "workspace" in customer-facing guides, but keep API examples as "tenant". I'll add a compact callout explaining the difference.

maya: Done. Also added an appendix with an SDK-to-YAML mapping table so folks can translate examples.

sam: LGTM from engineering side after doc CI passes. @docs-bot can you queue a preview build?

docs-bot: Preview build queued for PR #824 by maya 12 - https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-824 - status: queued

liam: :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks y'all. Will merge once we have CI green + two approvals. If anyone spots phrasing that could be misread as a contractual promise about latency, flag it here before merge.
